mapper.sql: APLY_SN, APLY_NO, USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_ENPSWD, USER_SE_NM, OGDP_BZENTY_NM, DEPT_NM, MBL_TELNO, TELNO, EML_ADDR, DMND_AUTHRT_NM, APLY_RSN, APLY_DT, APLY_STTS_NM, APRV_USER_SN, APRV_DT, RFSL_RSN
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE USER_ID = #{_parameter}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_acnt_aply_info WHERE USER_ID = #{_parameter} AND APLY_STTS_NM IN ('승인대기', '승인완료'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_acnt_aply_info (APLY_NO, USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_ENPSWD, USER_SE_NM, OGDP_BZENTY_NM, DEPT_NM, MBL_TELNO, TELNO, EML_ADDR, DMND_AUTHRT_NM, APLY_RSN, APLY_DT, APLY_STTS_NM) VALUES (#{aplyNo}, #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{userEnpswd}, #{userSeNm}, #{ogdpBzentyNm}, #{deptNm}, #{mobileNo}, #{telno}, #{emlAddr}, #{dmndAuthrtNm}, #{aplyRsn}, NOW(), #{aplySttsNm})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM user_acnt_aply_info WHERE 1 = 1
AND APLY_STTS_NM = #{aplySttsNm}
AND ( USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR OGDP_BZENTY_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR DEPT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY APLY_DT DESC, APLY_SN DESC
SELECT FROM user_acnt_aply_info WHERE APLY_SN = #{_parameter} FOR UPDATE
SELECT AUTHRT_SN FROM authrt_info WHERE AUTHRT_NM = #{_parameter} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND AUTHRT_STTS_NM = '사용' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_acnt_aply_info SET APLY_STTS_NM = '승인완료', APRV_USER_SN = #{aprvUserSn}, APRV_DT = NOW(), RFSL_RSN = NULL WHERE APLY_SN = #{aplySn} AND APLY_STTS_NM = '승인대기'
